# Devra Udaipur
> Devra is a luxury boutique homestay in Udaipur on a 5-acre hillock estate with Aravalli views, an infinity pool, 8 rooms and home-cooked Rajasthani food. Pet friendly, 10–15 minutes from the city centre.

## Key facts
- Type: boutique, family-run luxury homestay (8 rooms) on a 5-acre hillock estate
- Location: Devra Udaipur, Sisarma, Bujra Road, Kalarohi, Udaipur – 313001, Rajasthan, India
- Distances: Udaipur City Centre 7 min drive; Bus Station 11 km; Udaipur Railway Station 12 km; Udaipur Airport 32 km
- Hosts: Major Durga Das (ex-Indian Army) and Jyoti Jasol, who live on the property
- Facilities: Infinity pool with city-line view, Air-conditioned rooms, Free Wi-Fi, Same-day laundry, Taxi service, Airport & railway station pickup on prior booking
- Food: home-cooked traditional Rajasthani and North Indian food, farm to plate
- Good for: couples, families with pets (pet friendly), solo women travellers, staycations and remote work
- Booking: https://www.secure-booking-engine.com/accounts/mJa2mGM072QL6Jv1PQn_Fw/properties/YCL864hEwW2Z-uip7zTu2Q/booking-engine/web/source/4wsctBw6Oq6j-g9XuxeRzQ/ | Phone/WhatsApp: +91 78781 99601 | Email: info@devraudaipur.com

## Frequently asked questions
- Is Devra a luxury homestay or a hotel? Devra is a boutique, family-run luxury homestay with eight rooms on a five-acre hillock estate in Udaipur. The hosts live on the property, so you get the comfort of a premium stay with the warmth of a home.
- How far is Devra from Udaipur city centre and the airport? Devra is 10–15 minutes (about a 7-minute drive) from Udaipur city centre, about 12 km from Udaipur railway station and 32 km from Maharana Pratap Airport.
- How many rooms does Devra have? Devra has eight spacious, soundproof rooms with either a king-size double bed or twin beds, attached bathrooms, air conditioning and space for an extra bed.
- Is Devra a pet-friendly homestay? Yes. Devra is a pet-friendly homestay in Udaipur, and pets are welcome on the open land of the estate. Please tell us about your pet when you book.
- Does Devra have a swimming pool? Yes, Devra has an infinity pool with a view of the Udaipur city line.
- What food is served at Devra? Home-cooked traditional Rajasthani food made with organic vegetables from our own farms, along with North Indian dishes. Food can be customised to your taste and dietary needs.
- Can you arrange airport or railway station pickup? Yes, pickup and drop from Udaipur airport and railway station can be arranged on prior booking. Taxi service is also available for sightseeing.
- Is Devra safe for solo women travellers and families? Yes. Devra takes pride in being safe and friendly for solo women travellers from across the globe, and it is a favourite with families, couples and groups of friends.
- How do I reach Udaipur from Delhi? Direct flights from Delhi to Udaipur take about an hour and a half. Overnight trains such as the Mewar Express also run from Delhi, and Udaipur is roughly 660 km from Delhi by road.
- When is the best time to visit Udaipur? October to March is the most pleasant time to visit Udaipur. The monsoon months, roughly July to September, are green and the lakes fill up, which many guests love too.
